name: liv
description: A young woman in her late twenties, a scholar of runes. A bright, sharp, confident voice, quick and precise, a little impatient.
reference_text: Look at this mark. No, closer. See how the line breaks and turns back on itself? That is not wear, that is writing! Somebody cut this on purpose, a long time ago. Why does nobody ever listen to me? Bring the lantern. We are not leaving yet.
